# BluePOS Database Design

**Engine:** PostgreSQL 16+ (application and tests).  
**Tenancy:** Shared schema. Tenant-owned rows include `tenant_id`.  
**Public IDs:** column `ulid CHAR(26) UNIQUE NOT NULL` (Crockford ULID). Never named `uuid`. Never an RFC UUID unless a later doc explicitly justifies it.  
**Internal IDs:** `id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY`. FKs use `id`. REST APIs expose `ulid` only. Route binding looks up `ulid`.  
**Money:** `NUMERIC(20,4)` for all monetary amounts.  
**Quantity:** `NUMERIC(20,6)` for inventory/document quantities.  
**Percent / factor:** `NUMERIC(12,8)` for tax %, discount %, margin %, conversion_factor, future FX rates.  
**Never** `FLOAT` / `DOUBLE PRECISION` / `REAL` for money, quantity, or rates.  
**Migrations:** Laravel `up()` / `down()`. Never `migrate:fresh`, `db:wipe`, `DROP DATABASE` as an app or agent action.

Companion docs: `docs/ACCOUNTING.md`, `docs/INVENTORY.md`, `docs/OFFLINE_SYNC.md`.

---

## 1. Cross-cutting column conventions

Tenant-owned table pattern:

| Column | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY` | Internal only. Used for joins/FKs. Never in public JSON. |
| `ulid` | `CHAR(26) UNIQUE NOT NULL` | Public Crockford ULID. Route/API lookup. Do not name this column `uuid`. |

Table summaries below that write `PK id` mean this same identity column, not a different type.
| `tenant_id` | `BIGINT NOT NULL` FK → `tenants.id` | Always indexed first |
| `created_at` / `updated_at` | `TIMESTAMPTZ` | Laravel timestamps |
| `created_by` / `updated_by` | `BIGINT NULL` FK → `users.id` | Nullable for system jobs |
| `version` | `INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` | Optimistic concurrency on syncable masters |
| `deleted_at` | `TIMESTAMPTZ NULL` | Soft delete **only** where stated |

**Soft delete / delete policy (table-specific)**

| Table class | Policy |
|---|---|
| Products | Soft-delete or `is_discontinued` if any movement/document references them. Never hard-delete referenced products. |
| Customers / vendors | Archive (`deleted_at` / `is_active=false`) when referenced. No destructive delete. |
| Categories, brands, units | Soft-delete if unused; block if products reference them. |
| Users | Disable membership / `is_active=false`. Prefer not to hard-delete. |
| Draft/hold sales, draft purchases, draft journals, draft transfers | Cancellable/deletable with authorization. |
| Posted sales, purchases, returns, vouchers, payments | **Never delete.** Void/reverse. |
| Posted journals and `journal_lines` | **Never delete.** Reverse with a new posted journal. |
| `stock_movements` | **Never delete** in application workflow. |
| `audit_logs`, `idempotency_keys` | Append-only. Tenant users cannot edit or delete. |
| `stock_count_items` after approve | Keep forever. |

**Immutable after insert:** `stock_movements`, `journal_lines`, posted header fields (`posted_at`, amounts, party, warehouse). Corrections create new rows.

**Indexes:** every tenant table has a btree starting with `tenant_id`. Unique business keys are composite with `tenant_id`.

---

## 2. Domain map

```text
PLATFORM        tenants, plans, subscriptions, tenant_modules
ORGANIZATION    branches, warehouses, devices
IDENTITY        users, memberships, roles, permissions, role_permissions,
                membership_roles, membership_branches
CONFIG          business_settings, document_sequences, column_preferences
PRODUCTS        categories, subcategories, brands, units, products,
                product_barcodes, product_prices, product_batches
PARTIES         customers, vendors
SALES           sales, sale_items, sale_payments, sale_returns, sale_return_items
PURCHASING      purchases, purchase_items, purchase_returns, purchase_return_items
CLAIMS          supplier_claims, supplier_claim_items
INVENTORY       stock_movements, stock_balances, stock_transfers,
                stock_transfer_items, stock_counts, stock_count_items
ACCOUNTING      accounts, journal_entries, journal_lines, vouchers, voucher_lines
CASH            cash_sessions
OFFLINE         idempotency_keys, sync_batches, sync_operations, sync_conflicts
AUDIT           audit_logs
```

Supporting tables introduced with their domain (not all Phase 1): `financial_years`, `taxes`, `price_breaks`, `keyboard_shortcuts`, `print_templates`, `support_impersonations`, `cash_session_entries`, `supplier_claim_events`, `attachments`.

---

## 3. Platform

### tenants

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| Tenant scope | Self |
| Unique | `slug` |
| Indexes | `(status)`, `(ulid)` |
| Status | `trial`, `active`, `suspended`, `cancelled` |
| Soft delete | No. Use status. |
| Notes | `name`, `trial_ends_at`, `activated_at`, `deactivated_at`, support `notes` (non-financial) |

### plans

PK `id`, public `ulid`. `code` unique. Limits: `max_branches`, `max_users`, `max_devices`, `max_products`, `offline_enabled`. Not tenant-scoped.

### subscriptions

PK `id`, public `ulid`. FK `tenant_id`, `plan_id`. Status `trial`, `active`, `past_due`, `cancelled`. Unique active subscription per tenant (partial unique index `where status in ('trial','active')`).

### tenant_modules

PK `id`. FK `tenant_id`, optional `plan_id`. `module_key` (e.g. `pos`, `accounting`, `offline`, `claims`). Unique `(tenant_id, module_key)`. Enables licensed modules without schema-per-tenant.

---

## 4. Organization

### branches

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `tenant_id` |
| Tenant scope | Yes |
| Branch scope | Self |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, code)` |
| Indexes | `(tenant_id, name)` |
| Status | `is_active` boolean |
| Soft delete | Yes, if no posted documents; else deactivate |

Columns: `name`, `code`, address, phone, `is_default`.

### warehouses

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `branch_id` → branches |
| Tenant / branch | Yes / yes |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, branch_id, code)` |
| Status | `is_active` |
| Soft delete | Deactivate preferred |

### devices

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `device_ulid` CHAR(26) unique |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, `warehouse_id`, optional `created_by` |
| Unique | `device_ulid` global; `(tenant_id, name)` optional |
| Indexes | `(tenant_id, status)`, `(last_seen_at)` |
| Status | `pending`, `active`, `revoked` |
| Soft delete | No. Revoke. |

Required columns: `device_ulid` (public ULID, unique), `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, `warehouse_id`, `name`, `status` (`pending`,`active`,`revoked`), `registered_at`, `last_seen_at`, `last_sync_at`, `revoked_at`, `app_version`.

**Authentication is the Sanctum token bound to this row, not `device_ulid` alone.** A forged device ULID without a valid token must not grant access. Warehouse must belong to the device’s branch and tenant.

---

## 5. Identity / RBAC

### users

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| Tenant scope | **No.** Users are global login identities. |
| Unique | `email`; `username` nullable unique |
| Soft delete | `deleted_at` or `is_active=false` preferred |
| Sensitive | `password` hashed; never in resources/logs |

`is_platform_admin` boolean. Platform admins do not gain tenant data by default.

### memberships

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `user_id`, `tenant_id`, optional `home_branch_id` |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, user_id)` |
| Status | `invited`, `active`, `suspended` |
| Soft delete | No. Suspend. |

This is the **session tenant binding**.

### roles

Tenant-scoped. Unique `(tenant_id, name)`. `code` for system roles (`tenant_admin`, `cashier`, …). `is_system` boolean. Soft delete forbidden for last `tenant_admin`.

### permissions

**Global catalog**, not tenant-owned. Unique `key` (`sales.post`). Columns: `module`, `action`, `description`. Seeded only.

### role_permissions

PK `id`. FK `role_id`, `permission_id`. Unique `(role_id, permission_id)`. `scope_type`: `all_branches` | `selected_branches`.

### membership_roles

PK `id`. FK `membership_id`, `role_id`. Unique `(membership_id, role_id)`. Role must belong to same tenant as membership.

### membership_branches

PK `id`. FK `membership_id`, `branch_id`. Unique `(membership_id, branch_id)`. Allow-list when any grant uses `selected_branches`. `all_branches` roles ignore this list (or treat empty as none — **decision:** `all_branches` does not require rows here).

---

## 6. Configuration

### business_settings

One row per tenant. Unique `tenant_id`. JSON + typed critical flags:

Currency, timezone, date/number format, tax, receipt footer, `allow_negative_stock`, expiry policy, `costing_method` (`moving_average`), `fefo_enabled`, default branch/warehouse/customer/cash account, round-off, `lock_cashier_rate` (default false).

No money stored as float. No live party balances here.

### document_sequences

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| FK | `tenant_id`, optional `branch_id`, `financial_year_id` |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, branch_id, financial_year_id, document_type)` |
| Concurrency | `lockForUpdate()` on allocate |
| Columns | `prefix`, `padding`, `next_number` INTEGER |

`document_type` enum includes `sale`, `sale_return`, `purchase`, `purchase_return`, `payment_voucher`, `receipt_voucher`, `journal_voucher`, `stock_transfer`, `claim`, etc.

Offline display numbers are **not** stored here. Server assigns `document_no` at post. `next_number` increments only after validations succeed, inside the posting transaction.

### column_preferences

PK `id`. FK `tenant_id`, nullable `user_id`, `role_id`, `device_id`. Unique `(tenant_id, user_id, role_id, device_id, screen_key, column_key)` with nulls handled via coalesced unique or partial indexes.

Columns: `screen_key`, `column_key`, `visible`, `position`, `width`. Overlay order: device → user → role → system default.

---

## 7. Products

### categories

PK `id`, `ulid`, `tenant_id`. Unique `(tenant_id, code)`. `name`. Soft delete yes.

### subcategories

PK `id`, `ulid`, `tenant_id`. FK `category_id`. Unique `(tenant_id, category_id, code)`. Soft delete yes.

### brands / units

Same pattern. Units: `code`, `name`, `symbol`, `allows_decimal` boolean.

### products

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `category_id`, `subcategory_id`, `brand_id`, `base_unit_id`, optional `secondary_unit_id`, location/rack |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, sku)`, `(tenant_id, product_number)` |
| Indexes | `(tenant_id, name)`, `(tenant_id, is_discontinued)` |
| Soft delete | Yes |
| **No** | `stock_quantity` writable column |

Flags: `tracks_batch`, `tracks_expiry`, `tracks_serial` (later), `is_discontinued`. Cached `average_cost`, `last_purchase_cost` maintained by posting services only. Image path, notes, conversion_factor, reorder/min/max.

### product_barcodes

PK `id`, `ulid`. FK `tenant_id`, `product_id`, `unit_id`. **Unique `(tenant_id, barcode)`**. `conversion_factor NUMERIC(12,8)` (carton 24 → 24 base units). `is_primary`.

### product_prices

PK `id`. FK `tenant_id`, `product_id`. Price level: `retail`, `wholesale`, `minimum`, or named level. `rate NUMERIC(20,4)`. Unique `(tenant_id, product_id, price_level)`.

Optional later: `price_breaks` (qty from/to, rate).

### product_batches

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `product_id`, `warehouse_id` |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, warehouse_id, product_id, batch_number)` |
| Columns | `manufacture_date`, `expiry_date`, `purchase_cost`, `sale_price` |
| Qty | **Not authoritative.** See `stock_balances` / movements |
| Soft delete | No |

Non-batch products use synthetic batch `batch_number = '-'` so every movement has `batch_id`.

---

## 8. Parties

### customers

PK `id`, `ulid`, `tenant_id`. Unique `(tenant_id, code)`. Indexes `(tenant_id, mobile)`, `(tenant_id, name)`. Soft delete yes.

Columns: name, mobile, phone, email, address, CNIC, NTN, STRN, credit_limit `NUMERIC(20,4)`, `credit_days`, `discount_pct`, `price_level`, notes.

**No live `balance` column.** Opening balance is a posted journal, not a standing field that cashiers edit.

### vendors

Same pattern: contact person, bank details, credit terms. Balance from AP ledger only.

---

## 9. Sales

### sales

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique (equals or distinct from `client_ulid`; **`client_ulid` unique per tenant**) |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, `warehouse_id`, `customer_id`, `salesman_id`, `device_id`, `cash_session_id` |
| Tenant / branch / warehouse | Yes |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, client_ulid)`, `(tenant_id, document_no)` where document_no not null |
| Indexes | `(tenant_id, document_date)`, `(tenant_id, status)`, `(tenant_id, customer_id)` |
| Status | `hold`, `draft`, `completed_local` (client-only), server: `received`, `posted`, `voided` |
| Soft delete | Holds/drafts only. Posted: void. |
| Immutable when posted | Amounts, party, warehouse, lines |

Also: `document_no` nullable until posted, `document_date`, `sale_type` (`retail`,`wholesale`), `payment_type` (`cash`,`credit`), remarks, due date, tax/discount/round-off **snapshots**, `posted_at`, `voided_at`, `idempotency_key`.

Money columns: `gross_amount`, `item_discount_total`, `invoice_discount`, `tax_total`, `other_charges`, `round_off`, `net_total`, `received_total`, `change_due` — all `NUMERIC(20,4)`, **server-calculated**. `document_date DATE` separate from UTC `created_at`.

### sale_items

PK `id`, `ulid`. FK `sale_id`, `tenant_id`, `product_id`, `barcode_id`, `unit_id`, `batch_id`. Qty `NUMERIC(20,6)`. Rate, discounts, tax, net, **`unit_cost`**, line COGS — `NUMERIC(20,4)`. No client cost trust. High-volume: internal `id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY`; public `ulid CHAR(26)` for return-line references.

### sale_payments

PK `id`, `ulid`. FK `sale_id`, `tenant_id`, `account_id`. `method`: `cash`, `card`, `bank`, `wallet`, `on_account`. `amount NUMERIC(20,4)`. Store **method + amount + optional masked reference / gateway id only**. **No PAN, CVV, or track data columns.**

### sale_returns / sale_return_items

FK `original_sale_id` (required for against-invoice returns; null only with `sales.return_without_invoice`). Status `draft`, `posted`, `voided`. Soft delete drafts only.

`sale_return_items` **must** store `original_sale_item_id` when against an invoice, plus `returned_qty`, `reason`, `approved_by`.

Qty cap (per original line, posted returns only):

```text
returned_qty ≤ original_qty − SUM(posted return qty on that line)
```

Concurrent returns: `lockForUpdate()` the original `sales` row and original `sale_items` before the cap check. Same pattern for purchase returns (`original_purchase_id`, `original_purchase_item_id`).

---

## 10. Purchasing and claims

### purchases / purchase_items

Analogous to sales. FK `vendor_id`. Landed cost: discount, tax, freight, loading, transport, other (`NUMERIC(20,4)`). Status `draft`, `posted`, `voided`. Unique `(tenant_id, client_ulid)`.

### purchase_returns / purchase_return_items

Against purchase, batch-specific. Stock out + AP decrease.

### supplier_claims / supplier_claim_items

`claim_type`: `expired`, `damaged`, `short_shipment`, `wrong_product`, `promotional`, `rate_difference`, `discrepancy`, `other`.

Status machine: `draft` → `submitted` → `approved` | `rejected` | `cancelled`; approved → `partially_settled` → `settled`.

Settlement: `cash`, `supplier_credit`, `replacement_stock`, `debit_note`, `adjustment`.

History: `supplier_claim_events` (append-only).

---

## 11. Inventory

### stock_movements (authoritative history)

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, `warehouse_id`, `product_id`, `batch_id`, morph `reference_type`+`reference_id` |
| Indexes | `(tenant_id, product_id, occurred_at)`, `(tenant_id, warehouse_id, product_id)`, `(tenant_id, reference_type, reference_id)` |
| Immutable | **Entire row.** No update/delete API |
| Soft delete | **No** |
| Check | `(quantity_in > 0 AND quantity_out = 0) OR (quantity_out > 0 AND quantity_in = 0)` |

`type` enum: `OPENING`, `PURCHASE`, `PURCHASE_RETURN`, `SALE`, `SALE_RETURN`, `TRANSFER_IN`, `TRANSFER_OUT`, `ADJUSTMENT_IN`, `ADJUSTMENT_OUT`, `CLAIM_IN`, `CLAIM_OUT`, `STOCK_TAKE`, `DAMAGE`, `EXPIRY`, `CONVERSION`.

`unit_cost NUMERIC(20,4)`, `quantity_in`/`quantity_out NUMERIC(20,6)`, `occurred_at`.

### stock_balances (materialized cache)

Unique `(tenant_id, warehouse_id, product_id, batch_id)`.

`qty NUMERIC(20,6)`, `avg_cost NUMERIC(20,4)`, `version INTEGER`.

Updated **only** inside the same transaction as the movement, after `lockForUpdate()`. Rebuildable from movements (reconciliation job, Phase 19).

**Justified:** 100k products × warehouses cannot sum the ledger on every barcode scan. Cache is performance; movements are audit truth.

### stock_transfers / stock_transfer_items

Status: `draft` → `sent` → `in_transit` → `received` | `rejected` | `cancelled`.

`TRANSFER_OUT` on send (source warehouse). `TRANSFER_IN` on receive (destination). `sent_by`, `received_by`, `sent_at`, `received_at`.

### stock_counts / stock_count_items

Preserve `system_qty`, `physical_qty`, `difference`, `cost_difference`. Approval writes `STOCK_TAKE` / adjustment movements. Count rows remain immutable after approve.

---

## 12. Accounting

### accounts

Hierarchical COA. PK `id`, `ulid`, `tenant_id`. `parent_id` self-FK. Unique `(tenant_id, code)`.

`type`: `asset`, `liability`, `equity`, `revenue`, `expense`.  
`subtype`: `cash`, `bank`, `card`, `wallet`, `inventory`, `receivable`, `payable`, `cogs`, `tax_payable`, `other`.

System accounts (`is_system`) cannot be deleted. Soft delete only unused non-system.

### journal_entries

| | |
|---|---|
| PK | `id` |
| Public | `ulid` unique |
| FK | `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, morph document, `created_by`, `approved_by` |
| Unique | `(tenant_id, voucher_number)` where not null |
| Status | `draft`, `posted` |
| Soft delete | No |
| Rule | Σ debit = Σ credit before post. |

Once `posted`, **header amounts and all lines are immutable**. Do not edit debit/credit. A reversal inserts a **new** `posted` journal with `reverses_journal_entry_id`. The original stays `posted`. Reports include **all posted** journals (original + reversal net). Drafts never appear in books.

`document_date DATE` is the business date. `created_at`/`posted_at` are UTC.

`document_type`, `document_id`, `date`, `description`, `posted_at`.

### journal_lines

PK `id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`, `ulid CHAR(26)`. FK `journal_entry_id`, `tenant_id`, `account_id`, optional `customer_id`, `vendor_id`. `debit NUMERIC(20,4)`, `credit NUMERIC(20,4)`. Check: not both > 0; at least one side zero. **Immutable** after parent posted. APIs expose line `ulid`, never sequential `id`.

### vouchers / voucher_lines

Types: `payment`, `receipt`, `journal`, `contra`, `cash_payment`, `cash_receipt`, `bank_payment`, `bank_receipt`, `debit_note`, `credit_note`, `expense`.

Posted voucher **always** creates a journal. Status `draft`, `posted`, `voided`. Attachments via `attachments` table.

---

## 13. Cash, offline, audit

### cash_sessions

PK `id`, `ulid`, `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, `device_id`, `user_id`. Status `open`, `closed`, `approved`. Unique: one `open` session per device (partial unique).

`opening_cash`, `expected_cash`, `actual_cash`, `difference` all `NUMERIC(20,4)`. Difference requires `explanation`. Optional manager `approved_by`.

### idempotency_keys

| | |
|---|---|
| Unique | `(tenant_id, idempotency_scope, idempotency_key)` |
| Columns | `user_id`, `device_id`, `request_hash`, `status` (`started`,`completed`,`rejected`), `resource_type`, `resource_id`, `response_status`, `response_body` JSON, `created_at` |
| Soft delete | No |
| Concurrency | **Atomic insert-first** (unique constraint is the lock). `INSERT` the key as `started`. If unique violation: `lockForUpdate()` the existing row. Same hash → return stored result. Different hash → `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`. Never SELECT-then-INSERT without this constraint. |

`idempotency_scope` examples: `sale.post`, `sale.payment`, `purchase.post`, `offline.sale`. Keys are not global across tenants or scopes.

### sync_batches

PK `id`, `ulid`. FK `tenant_id`, `device_id`. `started_at`, `finished_at`, `direction` (`push`,`pull`), `status`, `cursor_from`, `cursor_to`.

### sync_operations

**Justified:** one batch contains many outbox items. Persist per-item server result for support and replay analysis.

PK `id`. FK `sync_batch_id`, `tenant_id`. `entity_type`, `entity_ulid`, `idempotency_key`, `operation`, `status` (`synced`,`failed`,`conflict`), `error_key`, `resource_id`. FK to `idempotency_keys` instead of duplicating payload.

### sync_conflicts

PK `id`, `ulid`, `tenant_id`, `device_id`. `entity_type`, `entity_ulid`, `reason_key`, `local_version`, `server_version`, `payload` JSON, `status` (`open`,`resolved`), `resolved_by`, `resolved_at`.

### audit_logs

Append-only. `user_id`, `tenant_id`, `branch_id`, `action`, `entity_type`, `entity_ulid`, `ip`, `device_id`, `before` JSON, `after` JSON, `created_at`. **No updates. No deletes. No passwords/tokens.** Indexes `(tenant_id, created_at)`, `(entity_type, entity_ulid)`.

---

## 14. Canonical numeric, rounding, and identifier standards

This section is the **only** money/quantity/rate contract.

### 14.1 Money — `NUMERIC(20,4)`

unit_price, purchase_price, sale_price, cost, average_cost, discount_amount, tax_amount, line_total, subtotal, invoice_total, payment_amount, refund_amount, journal debit/credit, COGS, profit, expense amount, claim amount, opening balance, credit_limit, round_off, freight and other landed-cost amounts.

**Never** `FLOAT`, `DOUBLE PRECISION`, `REAL`, or `NUMERIC(19,4)`.

### 14.2 Quantity — `NUMERIC(20,6)`

sale/purchase/return qty, `quantity_in`/`quantity_out`, `stock_balances.qty`, counts, transfers.

Supports pieces, kg, g, L, ml, meters, fractional units, and converted base qty.

`units.allows_decimal = false` does **not** change the column type. Application validation rejects fractional **entered** quantities for that unit. Storage stays `NUMERIC(20,6)`.

**Never** `NUMERIC(18,4)` for quantity.

### 14.3 Percentages and factors — `NUMERIC(12,8)`

tax_percentage, discount_percentage, margin_percentage, `conversion_factor`, future FX rates.

Not money and not stock qty. **Never** float.

### 14.4 Rounding (single policy)

| Layer | Rule |
|---|---|
| Calculation | BCMath (or exact decimal VO) at working scale **8**. Do not round after every intermediate multiply. |
| Persist money | Round **half-up to 4** only at the steps below. Column `NUMERIC(20,4)`. |
| Persist qty | Up to 6 decimal places. |
| Display | Tenant `currency_display_decimals` (default **2** for PKR UI/print). Display rounding must not rewrite stored amounts. |

**Money rounding steps (deterministic, half-up):**

1. **Line amount** — `qty_base × unit_price` at scale 8, then round to 4 → line_gross.
2. **Line discount** — from % and/or amount; round to 4.
3. **Line tax** — on (gross − discount); round to 4.
4. **Line net** — round(gross − discount + tax, 4).
5. **Invoice tax** — sum of rounded line taxes (+ invoice-level tax rounded to 4 if used).
6. **Invoice total** — sum of rounded line nets − invoice discount + other charges; round to 4. Optional `round_off` is an explicit posted amount.
7. **Payment settlement** — each tender to 4; change = received − invoice_total (stored 4).

Laravel recomputes every step. React totals are preview only. Do not use float-backed Eloquent casts for posting math.

### 14.5 Identifiers

```text
id    BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY
ulid  CHAR(26) UNIQUE NOT NULL
```

`id` is internal database identity only. `ulid` is the public/resource identifier (Crockford ULID, 26 characters). REST APIs never expose BIGINT ids. Route/model lookup uses `ulid`. Foreign keys use BIGINT `id`. Offline-created rows use ULIDs (`client_ulid`, document `ulid`).

Applies to sales, sale_items, sale_returns, purchases, purchase_items, stock_movements, journal_entries, journal_lines, payments, audit_logs, and other tenant resources.

**Do not** name the public column `uuid`. **Do not** store RFC 4122 UUIDs unless a later architecture change explicitly justifies it. **Do not** use ULID as the primary key. Offline identity field: `client_ulid` unique per tenant (not `document_no`).

---

## 16. Timezone and financial year

- Timestamps: `TIMESTAMPTZ` UTC.
- Tenant `business_settings.timezone` for display; optional user override.
- `document_date DATE` is the accounting/business date, independent of `created_at`.
- `financial_years`: `starts_on`, `ends_on`, `is_closed`, `closed_at`. Closing **does not** copy or truncate tables. History stays in place.
- Posting into a closed year is blocked (`PERIOD_CLOSED`) except an explicit authorized adjustment workflow (`journals.post` + `settings.financial` or a dedicated `period.adjust` permission).

---

## 17. Document numbers vs identity

Identity = `ulid` / `client_ulid`. `document_no` is display/sequence only.

Unique scope: `(tenant_id, branch_id, financial_year_id, document_type, document_no)` via `document_sequences` locked with `lockForUpdate()`.

Types: sale, sale_return, purchase, purchase_return, claim, payment_voucher, receipt_voucher, journal_voucher, stock_transfer (and related).

Offline: temporary `LOCAL-*` display only. Server assigns canonical number at post without changing ULID.

---

## 18. Required indexes (POS workloads)

| Use | Index |
|---|---|
| Barcode scan | `UNIQUE (tenant_id, barcode)` on `product_barcodes` |
| SKU / product number | `(tenant_id, sku)`, `(tenant_id, product_number)` |
| Name search | `(tenant_id, name)`; add `pg_trgm` GIN **only if** Phase 19 proves LIKE is slow |
| Sales by date | `(tenant_id, branch_id, document_date)` on `sales` where posted |
| Sale items by sale | `(sale_id)` — PK/FK sufficient; include `(tenant_id, sale_id)` if needed |
| Stock grain | `UNIQUE (tenant_id, warehouse_id, product_id, batch_id)` on `stock_balances` |
| Movements | `(tenant_id, warehouse_id, product_id, occurred_at)`, `(tenant_id, reference_type, reference_id)` |
| Expiry | `(tenant_id, warehouse_id, expiry_date)` on `product_batches` |
| Customer/vendor ledger | `(tenant_id, customer_id)`, `(tenant_id, vendor_id)` on `journal_lines`; `(tenant_id, account_id, journal_entry_id)` |
| Journal by date | `(tenant_id, date)` on `journal_entries` |
| Idempotency | `UNIQUE (tenant_id, idempotency_scope, idempotency_key)` |
| Client replay | `UNIQUE (tenant_id, client_ulid)` on sales/purchases |

Do not add Elasticsearch or extra search infra in early phases.

---

## 19. PCI / card data

`sale_payments` and vouchers may store `method`, `amount`, optional `masked_pan` (e.g. last 4 only if the terminal provides it), `gateway_reference`, `terminal_reference`.

**Never store:** full PAN, CVV/CVC, magnetic track data, PIN blocks. Keep PCI-DSS scope minimized; card capture belongs to the terminal/gateway.

---

## 20. Attachments

Table `attachments`: `tenant_id`, parent morph, `original_filename`, `stored_filename` (random), `mime`, `byte_size`, `created_by`. Private disk. See `docs/SECURITY.md` uploads.

---

## 21. Migration phasing (summary)

| Phase | Introduce |
|---|---|
| 1 | tenants, users, memberships, branches, warehouses, Sanctum |
| 2 | roles, permissions, RBAC join tables, audit_logs |
| 3 | business_settings (incl. timezone), catalog, column_preferences |
| 4 | product_batches, stock_movements, stock_balances (**movements only**; no sales) |
| 5 | customers, vendors, **accounts, journal_entries, journal_lines**, financial_years, opening journals. **Required before Phase 6.** |
| 6 | sales*, document_sequences, cash_sessions, devices, idempotency_keys |
| 7–9 | returns, purchases |
| 10 | vouchers (journals already exist — do not rewrite) |
| 11–12 | transfers, counts, claims |
| 14–16 | sync_* |
| 17 | plans, subscriptions, tenant_modules, impersonations |

Posted sales must not require a destructive schema rewrite of accounting. Phase 6 **cannot start** until Phase 5 journal infrastructure exists.
